ambiguous-duplicate.json.description: Two candidate windows tie for best score >= 60%

collar-only-single-line.json.description: Single-line comment where line itself was edited but 3+3 collar lines match

cross-side-partial-resolve.json.description: Dual-sided anchor where new side resolves and old side orphans

deleted-file.json.description: Recorded path absent from target tree and no content candidate found

deleted-line-old-side.json.description: Old-side anchor on deleted line evaluated against tree where content has 0 matching score

drift-within-file.json.description: File edited with inserted lines: range shifted to new line numbers

elided-long-range.json.description: Elided long range (omitted > 0) matches head-32 and tail-32 verbatim

exact-blob-moved.json.description: File moved to new path with identical content

exact-path-blob.json.description: File untouched at recorded path: range and context carry over verbatim

malformed-cross-side.json.description: Old side fails the structural pre-check (elided context shorter than 64 lines) while new side resolves exactly; scope is per-side, so the anchor resolves partial

malformed-short-range-elided.json.description: Elided context (omitted > 0) on a range shorter than 64 lines; the resolver ladder must not index into it (WRIT-252 repro 1)

malformed-single-line-elided.json.description: Elided context on a single-line range against a one-line file; the resolver ladder must not index into it (WRIT-252 repro, index out of range [1])

malformed-version-string.json.description: Anchor version encoded as a JSON string ("1") rather than an integer; the whole anchor decode fails, orphaning every present side malformed (WRIT-252 repro 2)

rename-and-edit.json.description: File renamed and edited: lines found verbatim in new file

threshold-just-above.json.description: Fuzzy match scoring exactly 60% (6/10) passes threshold

threshold-just-below.json.description: Best candidate window scores below the 60% threshold (5/10)

whole-file-orphan.json.description: Whole-file anchor on file whose content changed in target tree

whole-file-resolve.json.description: Whole-file anchor on file whose blob matches target tree
